notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 106–568, title VII, § 702, Dec. 27, 2000, 114 Stat. 2913, which set out Congressional findings, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 106–568, title VII, § 701, Dec. 27, 2000, 114 Stat. 2913, provided that title VII of Pub. L. 106–568, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Shawnee Tribe Status Act of 2000”.
